```json
 "topology": "Two-stage Miller (NMOS input, PMOS mirror, PMOS CS output, Rz nulling)",
 "rationale": "Two gain stages give about 70 dB. The NMOS input pair suits VCM = 0.9 V because pfet Vth is about 1 V. Long, wide input devices keep flicker noise low. GBW = gm1/(2*pi*Cc) is set to about 15 MHz with Cc = 2 pF. The second stage has gm6 of about 1.6 mS, more than 4x gm1*CL/Cc, so PM is above 60 degrees. Rz moves the zero into the LHP. Budget is 10 + 10 (ref) + 30 (tail) + 200 (out) uA, about 0.45 mW."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (16, 10, 22),          # input pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.5, 3.0),       # input pair L (flicker noise / gain)
    "itail": (30e-6, 10e-6, 80e-6), # first-stage tail current
    "gmidp": (8, 5, 12),            # PMOS mirror + M6 gm/Id (matched -> no systematic offset)
    "Lp":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.5),       # PMOS L (M3/M4/M6 identical density)
    "i2":    (200e-6, 80e-6, 350e-6), # second-stage current
    "gmidn": (9, 6, 13),            # NMOS current-source gm/Id
    "Ln":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),       # NMOS current-source L
    "cc":    (2e-12, 0.8e-12, 4e-12),
    "rzk":   (1.5, 1.0, 3.0),       # Rz = rzk / gm6
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    it, i2, cc = p["itail"], p["i2"], p["cc"]
    i1 = it / 2

    # input pair (source ~0.3 V -> body effect included)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], i1, vds=0.5, vsb=0.3)
    # PMOS mirror load and second-stage device: same gm/Id and L
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], i1, vds=0.9)
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], i2, vds=0.9)
    # NMOS bias mirror: reference diode, tail, output sink
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.6)
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], it, vds=0.3)
    m7 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], i2, vds=0.9)

    rz = p["rzk"] / m6.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    # first stage: vinp -> M1 drives diode side, so out1 (M2 drain) is inverting w.r.t. vinp
    # out1 drives PMOS CS (inverting) -> vout non-inverting w.r.t. vinp
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "out1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "out1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    # second stage
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "out1", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    # Miller compensation with nulling resistor
    n.R("RZ", "out1", "cz", rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", cc)

    # predictions
    gm1 = m1.gm
    a1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    a2 = m6.gm / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    gain_db = db(a1 * a2)
    gbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cc)
    c1 = m6.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    p2 = m6.gm * cc / (2 * PI * (c1 * cc + c1 * cl + cc * cl))
    pm_mirror = math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / (m3.gm / (2 * PI * 2 * m3.cgg))))
    # LHP zero from Rz > 1/gm6
    wz = 1.0 / (cc * (rz - 1.0 / m6.gm)) if rz > 1.0 / m6.gm else 1e30
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / p2)) - pm_mirror + \
         math.degrees(math.atan(2 * PI * gbw / wz))
    kT = 1.380649e-23 * 300.15
    sv2 = 2 * (8.0 / 3.0) * kT / gm1 * (1 + m3.gm / gm1)
    noise_th = math.sqrt(sv2)
    power = vdd * (iref + iref + it + i2)
    slew = min(it / cc, i2 / (cc + cl))
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": gbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "noise_1k": noise_th * 2.0, "slew": slew}
```
